TITLE: ASML Q3 2026: orders confirm the upcycle, valuation leaves little slack
QUOTE: Illustrative management quote of about twenty to thirty words that captures the tone of the call and the key message to investors.
QUOTE_WHO: Illustrative Name, CEO, Q3 2026 earnings call, 14 October 2026

TAKEAWAYS.label: Beat
TAKEAWAYS.text: Revenue EUR 9.2bn (+4% vs. consensus) and EPS EUR 7.85 (+6%), driven by EUV mix and services.

TAKEAWAYS.label: Raised
TAKEAWAYS.text: FY26 revenue guide lifted to the top of the EUR 34 to 36bn range; gross margin 52 to 53%.

TAKEAWAYS.label: Watch
TAKEAWAYS.text: China fell to 22% of system sales from 29%, and export-licence timing remains the main swing factor.

TAKEAWAYS.label: Valuation
TAKEAWAYS.text: 30.6x forward earnings, 18% above the 2010 to 2026 average: the upcycle is priced, not the next leg.

H_P1: What the quarter means for the investment case
P1_PARAGRAPH: Orders of EUR 7.1bn beat consensus by 12% and the EUV share rose to 58%, the highest since Q2 2024, while gross margin reached 53.4% against a guide of 51 to 53%. We read the mix shift as structural rather than cyclical, and the guidance for Q4 implies a run-rate above the FY27 consensus. The debate now moves from demand to capacity.
